units.text: For the purpose of ensuring the sustainable economic and social development of the Russian Federation, strengthening state sovereignty, sovereignty in culture and values, and economic sovereignty, increasing the population of the country and improving citizens’ standard of living, on the basis of traditional Russian spiritual and moral values and the principles of patriotism, the primacy of the human person, social justice and equality of opportunity, ensuring state security and public safety, openness to the outside world, and economic development based on fair competition, entrepreneurship and private initiative, high efficiency and technological sophistication, I hereby decree:
units.label: Beginning of document · “For the purpose of ensuring the sustainable economic and social…”

units.text: 1. Establish the following national development goals of the Russian Federation for the period up to 2030 and the outlook up to 2036 (hereinafter referred to as the national goals):
units.label: Point 1

units.text: а) preserving the population, improving health and increasing people’s well-being, and supporting the family;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1

units.text: б) realizing each person’s potential, developing their talents, and fostering a patriotic and socially responsible individual;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1

units.text: в) a comfortable and safe living environment;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1

units.text: г) environmental well-being;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 1

units.text: д) a sustainable and dynamic economy;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 1

units.text: е) technological leadership;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 1

units.text: ж) digital transformation of state and municipal administration, the economy and the social sphere.
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 1

units.text: 2. Establish the following targets and tasks whose fulfillment characterizes the achievement of the national goal ‘Preserving the population, improving health and increasing people’s well-being, and supporting the family’:
units.label: Point 2

units.text: а) increasing the total fertility rate to 1.6 by 2030 and to 1.8 by 2036, including annual growth in the total fertility rate for third and subsequent children;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2

units.text: б) increasing life expectancy to 78 years by 2030 and to 81 years by 2036, including faster growth in healthy life expectancy indicators;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2

units.text: в) ensuring, by 2030, that the rate of increase in the total fertility rate in constituent entities of the Russian Federation where this rate was below the Russian national average in 2023 is no lower than the Russian national average rate of increase;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2

units.text: г) reducing disparities in life expectancy indicators by at least 25 percent by 2036 compared with the 2023 level;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 2

units.text: д) reducing, by 2030, the total duration of temporary incapacity for work among citizens of working age by promoting a healthy lifestyle, creating conditions for timely disease prevention, and engaging citizens in regular sports activities;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 2

units.text: е) increasing, by 2030, citizens’ satisfaction with conditions for physical exercise and sports;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 2

units.text: ж) increasing, by 2030, the number of elderly citizens and persons with disabilities receiving long-term care services to at least 500 thousand persons from among those most in need of such services;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 2

units.text: з) increasing, by 2030, the satisfaction of participants in the special military operation with conditions for medical rehabilitation, retraining and employment;
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 2

units.text: и) creating and launching, by 2030, a digital platform that helps build, maintain and preserve human health throughout life, based on the principle of data-driven management;
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 2

units.text: к) reducing the poverty rate to below 7 percent by 2030 and below 5 percent by 2036, including reducing the poverty rate among families with many children to 12 percent by 2030 and to 8 percent by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «к» Point 2

units.text: л) reducing the Gini coefficient (income concentration index) to 0.37 by 2030 and to 0.33 by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «л» Point 2

units.text: м) ensuring an accelerated increase in the minimum wage, including increasing it by 2030 to more than twice the amount established for 2023, reaching at least 35 thousand rubles per month;
units.label: Subpoint «м» Point 2

units.text: н) approving in 2026 new remuneration systems for employees of state and municipal organizations and introducing these systems from 2027 to ensure growth in the incomes of public-sector employees as provided for by Presidential Decrees of the Russian Federation No. 597 of 7 May 2012 ‘On Measures to Implement State Social Policy’, No. 761 of 1 June 2012 ‘On the National Strategy for Action in the Interests of Children for 2012–2017’, and No. 1688 of 28 December 2012 ‘On Certain Measures to Implement State Policy for the Protection of Orphans and Children Left without Parental Care’.
units.label: Subpoint «н» Point 2

units.text: 3. Establish the following targets and tasks whose fulfillment characterizes the achievement of the national goal ‘Realizing each person’s potential, developing their talents, and fostering a patriotic and socially responsible individual’:
units.label: Point 3

units.text: а) creating, by 2030, conditions for fostering a harmoniously developed, patriotic and socially responsible individual on the basis of traditional Russian spiritual, moral, cultural and historical values;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3

units.text: б) increasing, by 2030, the number of foreign students enrolled in higher education programs at Russian higher education institutions and scientific organizations to at least 500 thousand;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3

units.text: в) increasing, by 2030, the proportion of young people participating in projects and programs aimed at professional and personal development and patriotic education to at least 75 percent;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3

units.text: г) increasing, by 2030, the proportion of young people who believe in opportunities for self-realization in Russia to at least 85 percent;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 3

units.text: д) increasing, by 2030, the proportion of young people involved in voluntary and community activities to at least 45 percent;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 3

units.text: е) ensuring, by 2030, the operation of an effective system for identifying, supporting and developing the abilities and talents of children and young people, based on the principles of responsibility, fairness and universality and aimed at self-determination and vocational guidance for 100 percent of learners;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 3

units.text: ж) ensuring the promotion and protection of traditional Russian spiritual and moral values in at least 70 percent of projects in culture, the arts and folk creativity funded by state development institutions by 2030, and in at least 80 percent of such projects by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 3

units.text: з) increasing, by 2030, citizens’ satisfaction with the work of state and municipal organizations in culture, the arts and folk creativity;
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 3

units.text: и) establishing, by 2030, a modern system of professional development for teaching staff at all levels of education, providing for annual additional professional education, based on updated professional standards, for at least 10 percent of teaching staff at leading higher education institutions and scientific organizations.
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 3

units.text: 4. Establish the following targets and tasks whose fulfillment characterizes the achievement of the national goal ‘A comfortable and safe living environment’:
units.label: Point 4

units.text: а) improving the quality of the living environment in key settlements by 30 percent by 2030 and by 60 percent by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 4

units.text: б) providing citizens with housing with a total floor area of at least 33 square meters per person by 2030 and at least 38 square meters by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 4

units.text: в) renewing at least 20 percent of the housing stock by 2030 compared with the 2019 figure;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 4

units.text: г) steadily reducing the stock of housing unfit for habitation;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 4

units.text: д) increasing the affordability of housing on the primary market;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 4

units.text: е) improving at least 30 thousand public spaces and implementing, in small towns and historic settlements, at least 1600 winning projects of the All-Russian Competition for the Best Projects to Create a Comfortable Urban Environment by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 4

units.text: ж) implementing a program to modernize utility infrastructure and improving the quality of utility services provided to 20 million people by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 4

units.text: з) constructing and reconstructing (modernizing) at least 2 thousand drinking water supply and water treatment facilities by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «з» Point 4

units.text: и) ensuring a significant increase in energy and resource efficiency in housing and utilities, industrial construction and infrastructure construction;
units.label: Subpoint «и» Point 4

units.text: к) increasing, by 2030, the share of the public transport fleet in urban agglomerations and cities whose service life does not exceed the prescribed standard to at least 85 percent;
units.label: Subpoint «к» Point 4

units.text: л) increasing, by 2030, the share of roads meeting regulatory requirements to at least 85 percent for federal roads and roads in the largest urban agglomerations, at least 85 percent for the backbone road network, and at least 60 percent for roads of regional or intermunicipal significance;
units.label: Subpoint «л» Point 4

units.text: м) reducing mortality from road traffic accidents by a factor of one and a half by 2030 and by a factor of two by 2036 compared with the 2023 figure;
units.label: Subpoint «м» Point 4

units.text: н) increasing the population’s air travel mobility by at least 50 percent by 2030 compared with the 2023 figure, while ensuring that domestically manufactured aircraft account for at least 50 percent of Russian air carriers’ fleets by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «н» Point 4

units.text: о) completing, by the end of 2030, major repairs to the buildings of preschool education institutions and general education institutions identified as requiring such repairs as of 1 January 2025;
units.label: Subpoint «о» Point 4

units.text: п) ensuring, under the social gasification program for the population, the connection of at least 1.6 million households to piped natural gas by 2030 and at least 3 million households by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «п» Point 4

units.text: р) equipping up to 900 audiovisual content playback centers in small settlements (with a population of up to 50 thousand people) with the necessary equipment by 2030, in order to provide citizens with access to the achievements of contemporary Russian cinema, and connecting these centers to a unified digital platform containing, among other things, an audiovisual content library.
units.label: Subpoint «р» Point 4

units.text: 5. Establish the following targets and tasks whose fulfillment characterizes the achievement of the national goal ‘Environmental well-being’:
units.label: Point 5

units.text: а) developing a circular economy that ensures, by 2030, the sorting of 100 percent of the municipal solid waste generated annually, the landfilling of no more than 50 percent of such waste, and the use of at least 25 percent of production and consumption waste in economic activity as secondary resources and raw materials;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 5

units.text: б) progressively halving, by 2036, emissions of hazardous pollutants with the greatest adverse impact on the environment and human health in cities with high and very high levels of ambient air pollution;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 5

units.text: в) eliminating at least 50 hazardous sites of accumulated environmental damage by the end of 2030 and recovering and rendering harmless at least 50 percent of the total volume of hazard class I and II waste by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 5

units.text: г) halving, by 2036, the volume of untreated wastewater discharged into major water bodies and preserving Lake Baikal’s unique ecological system;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 5

units.text: д) preserving forests and biodiversity, ensuring the sustainable development of specially protected natural areas, and creating conditions for ecotourism in all national parks.
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 5

units.text: 6. Establish the following targets and tasks whose fulfillment characterizes the achievement of the national goal ‘A sustainable and dynamic economy’:
units.label: Point 6

units.text: а) ensuring that the country’s gross domestic product grows faster than the world average and attaining, no later than 2030, fourth place in the world by gross domestic product calculated at purchasing power parity, including through labor productivity growth, while maintaining macroeconomic stability and low unemployment and reducing structural unemployment;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 6

units.text: б) reducing the share of imports of goods and services in gross domestic product to 17 percent by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 6

units.text: в) increasing fixed capital investment by at least 60 percent by 2030 compared with the 2020 level through continuous improvement of the investment climate;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 6

units.text: г) ensuring sustained growth in household incomes and pension provision at no less than the rate of inflation;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 6

units.text: д) ensuring, in 2024–2030, that real income growth per employee of a small or medium-sized enterprise is 1.2 times the growth of gross domestic product;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 6

units.text: е) ensuring that stock market capitalization increases to at least 66 percent of gross domestic product by 2030 and to 75 percent of gross domestic product by 2036, and that the share of citizens’ long-term savings in their total savings increases to at least 40 percent by 2030 and to 45 percent by 2036;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 6

units.text: ж) ensuring that the Russian Federation ranks among the world’s 25 leading countries in robot density by 2030;
units.label: Subpoint «ж» Point 6
